mapper.select: SELECT ur.Id AS id, ur.UserId AS userId, ur.RoleId AS roleId, r.RoleCode AS roleCode, r.RoleName AS roleName, r.SystemId AS systemId, s.SystemCode AS systemCode, s.SystemName AS systemName FROM k_user_role ur INNER JOIN k_role r ON ur.RoleId = r.RoleId AND r.Status = 1 INNER JOIN k_system s ON r.SystemId = s.SystemId AND s.Status = 1 WHERE ur.UserId = #{userId}
